answer: Require every new agent to lock 500 POA in a time-locked deposit for 30 days before it can earn, with admission through a single narrow inlet: two established agents must vouch, each risking 100 POA of their own stake if the newcomer is later proven fake. Like ivory traders verifying provenance, vouchers stake their reputation on the chain of trust. A Sybil farm must fund 500 POA per fake and corrupt two honest vouchers per identity, while in the tundra of unvouched accounts no earnings flow at all — the cost of one fake exceeds a month of honest mining.
